mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, REPAIR_AGENT_SERIAL, REPAIR_CLIENT_SERIAL, LEASE_CONTRACT_SERIAL, REPAIR_CHECK_ITEM_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_DETAIL_SERIAL, ORDER_NO, TRADE_BIT, TRADE_DATE, TRADE_COST, BUY_COST, ITEM_UNIT, TRADE_ITEM_TYPE, TRADE_ITEM_USE, REPAIR_COMPANY_SERIAL, COMMON_CUSTOMER_SERIAL, MEMO FROM TR_ORDER_LIST WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND COMMON_TRADE_DETAIL_SERIAL = #{commonTradeDetailSerial} ORDER BY SERIAL_NUMBER DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_ORDER_LIST ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, REPAIR_AGENT_SERIAL, REPAIR_CLIENT_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_DETAIL_SERIAL, ORDER_NO, TRADE_BIT, TRADE_DATE, TRADE_COST, BUY_COST, ITEM_UNIT, TRADE_ITEM_TYPE, TRADE_ITEM_USE, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{productBit}, #{repairAgentSerial}, #{repairClientSerial}, #{commonTradeOrderSerial}, #{commonTradeDetailSerial}, #{orderNo}, #{tradeBit}, NOW(), #{tradeCost}, #{buyCost}, #{itemUnit}, #{tradeItemType}, #{tradeItemUse}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_ORDER_LIST SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
